articles.title: Sunshine shopkeeper died after allegedly being bashed by a pack of children. Now a fundraiser for hero shopkeeper's funeral has hit just $880
articles.summary: Thousands of Victorians may have hit the streets to protest after the death of hero shopkeeper Van Viet Truong, but few have put their hands in their pockets for his devastated family.

articles.title: Report warns of U.S. shift away from prioritizing international religious freedom
articles.summary: A report warns that the U.S. has shifted away from a focus on international religious freedom. Alternatively, the State Department says Trump has made the U.S. “a global leader” on the issue.

articles.title: Lawmakers Raise Health Concerns Over Conditions at a South Texas Family Detention Center
articles.summary: Members of Congress report inadequate medical care at a South Texas family detention center. Immigration officials deny the allegations.
